description: This Java class provides utility methods for mocking, capturing, and matching Vert.x Handler objects in testing scenarios, specifically with Mockito and ArgumentCaptor. It supports type-safe handling of handlers and simplifies mock creation and argument capturing.

classes.name: VertxMockSupport
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to work with Vert.x Handler objects in mock testing, including matching, mocking, and capturing handlers.

methods.name: anyHandler
methods.description: Returns an ArgumentMatcher for any Handler of a specific type, excluding nulls.

methods.name: mockHandler
methods.description: Creates and returns a Mockito mock for a Handler of a specific type.

methods.name: argumentCaptorHandler
methods.description: Creates and returns an ArgumentCaptor for capturing Handler objects during mocking.
